label: Baloo access map
intro: A readable view of Baloo's explicit tool policy and each agent's narrower allowlist.

sections.title: Baloo — Alpar can work with
sections.description: Access is granted per tool namespace. A connection is not permission to reach unrelated data behind that service.

services.name: Web research
services.description: Search with SearXNG, fetch public pages, and render JavaScript sites in an isolated browser that cannot reach the LAN or cluster.

services.name: Places, routes & local time
services.description: Look up places, routes, directions, travel distances, coordinates, and destination-local timezone offsets.

services.name: Create & edit pictures
services.description: Create or edit images when explicitly requested, using the configured image-generation model.

services.name: Read & control the smart home
services.description: Read live household state and invoke only the controls exposed by the Home Assistant MCP tools.

services.name: Manage household tasks
services.description: Find, create, assign, move, update, complete, and reopen Vikunja tasks. There is intentionally no delete tool.

services.name: Plan trips & itineraries
services.description: Use the full exposed TREK tool surface for itineraries, packing, trip budgets, dates, members, and travel planning.

services.name: Work with the household budget
services.description: Use the enabled Actual MCP connection for the single configured household budget; other Baloo agents are explicitly denied this namespace.

services.name: Find & read project files
services.description: List, search, inspect metadata, read bounded text files, and inspect images below Baloo's configured WebDAV root.

services.name: Review & propose code changes
services.description: Read repositories and review state; create issues, comments, branches, file updates, and pull requests through the GitHub App.

services.name: Inspect cluster health
services.description: Get and describe cluster resources and read logs. RBAC excludes Secrets and ConfigMaps and grants no write verbs.

services.name: Schedule reminders
services.description: Create source-controlled scheduled reminders only when Alpar explicitly asks for one at a specific time.

sections.title: Hard limits
sections.description: These are enforced by tool deny lists, network policy, RBAC, or the available tool surface—not just prompt wording.

services.name: No cluster changes
services.description: Baloo cannot apply, create, patch, scale, restart, upgrade, exec into pods, or open Kubernetes port-forwards.

services.name: No privileged GitHub actions
services.description: It cannot merge pull requests, push arbitrary file sets, fork repositories, or create repositories.

services.name: No OpenCloud writes
services.description: The Alpar agent has only list, search, metadata, text-read, and image-read tools for the scoped Newjoy root.

services.name: No private browser reach
services.description: The browser pod cannot navigate to cluster, LAN, link-local, or tailnet addresses and cannot bypass logins, 2FA, or captchas.

services.name: No self-modification
services.description: Baloo cannot change its own prompts, tool policy, configuration, or agent workspace; those changes go through source control and ArgoCD.

sections.title: Other Baloo agents differ
sections.description: The gateway registers tools globally, but each agent receives its own strict allowlist and explicit denials.

services.name: Baloo — Kinga
services.description: Household web, maps, trips, OpenCloud reading, Home Assistant, tasks, GitHub workflows, images, and reminders; no Actual Budget or Kubernetes.

services.name: Cooking and Garden
services.description: Public web, the relevant life-repository workflow through branches and pull requests, plus live Home Assistant context only.

services.name: Trips
services.description: TREK, maps, timezones, and public web. It has no HA, GitHub, OpenCloud, Actual, tasks, images, or Kubernetes access and cannot create or delete trips.

services.name: Newjoy Studio
services.description: Public web plus a scoped Newjoy OpenCloud workflow that can organize folders and conditionally write YAML catalogs; no household or infrastructure tools.

services.name: Interior Designer
services.description: Public search, fetch, and isolated browser only. Every household, project, image-generation, task, and infrastructure namespace is denied.

services.name: Policy source
services.description: Review the exact per-agent allow and deny arrays in the private Baloo repository. This file remains the source of truth.
